# Analysis

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

##install.packages("fivethirtyeight")
library(fivethirtyeight)

candy <- fivethirtyeight::candy_rankings

candy <- candy |>
  mutate(type = case_when(
    chocolate & fruity ~ "both",
    chocolate ~ "chocolate",
    fruity ~ "fruity",
    .default = "other"
  ))#creates a new column

#count(candy, type)
```

## Row 1  {height="210px"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Least Sugary Candies"

list(
  icon = "arrow-down-circle",
  color = "warning",
  value = paste(candy$competitorname[candy$sugarpercent == min(candy$sugarpercent)], collapse = " and ")
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Most Sugary Candy"

list(
  icon = "arrow-up-circle",
  color = "secondary",
  value = candy$competitorname[candy$sugarpercent == max(candy$sugarpercent)]
)
```

## Row 2

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
#| echo: false
#| height: 450px

# Calculate the correlation coefficient (r)
r_value <- round(cor(candy$sugarpercent, candy$winpercent, use = "complete.obs"), 2)

# Creating a tooltip for the scatter plot and the linear line
scatter_tooltip <- paste0(
  "<b>", candy$competitorname, "</b>",
  "<br>Sugar Percentile: ", round(candy$sugarpercent, 2),
  "<br>Win Percentage: ", round(candy$winpercent, 1), "%"
)
line_tooltip <- paste0("Linear Trend Line<br>Correlation (r): ", r_value)

# Sugar level (x), Popularity (y) scatter plot
sugar_pop <- ggplot(candy, aes(sugarpercent, winpercent)) +
  geom_point(aes(text = scatter_tooltip)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(text = line_tooltip), method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#89C0AE") +
  labs(
    title = "Sugar Content vs Popularity",
    subtitle = "Does more sugar mean more popular?",
    x = "Sugar percentile compared to other candies",
    y = "Percentage of matchups the candy won"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

ggplotly(sugar_pop, tooltip = "text")
```
